scopes.why: Read the current Firebase Auth user (auth.currentUser) to expose the signed-in user via useAuth().
Sign the user out (signOut) when the app calls useAuth().signOut().
Upload objects to Cloud Storage for Firebase (uploadBytes) when the app calls useStorage().upload().
Remove objects from Cloud Storage for Firebase (deleteObject) when the app calls useStorage().remove().
Server-only: mint custom auth tokens and perform privileged admin operations using the service-account credential (firebase-admin). Never runs in the browser.
